title: AnMed
description:
anmed.org zoominfo.com/c/anmed/1238269198 AnMed is an independent, not-for-profit health system founded in 1908, serving Upstate South Carolina and northeast Georgia.
Its anchor facility, AnMed Medical Center, is a 461-bed acute care hospital located in Anderson, South Carolina.
The network provides comprehensive medical services, including emergency care, cardiovascular surgery, advanced imaging, and specialized outpatient clinics.
